_about: Which pre-PAIMANA project code (June 2025 flash report and earlier) each PAIMANA code (July 2026 flash report onward) replaced, for the Andhra Pradesh rows. PAIMANA renumbered every project and prints the old code as '-'. 'matched' pairs were found by app/scrapers/mospi_match.py on the evidence quoted; 'reviewed' pairs were checked by hand against both reports. scripts/mospi_renumbering.py check verifies every pair against the fixtures in tests/fixtures. Add a pair only with the evidence that justifies it.
